listed_quote.quote: The Fund's Board of Trustees has approved a proposal to reorganize the Fund into a newly created closed-end interval fund (the "Interval Fund").

announcement.quote: The Fund's Board of Trustees has approved a proposal to reorganize the Fund into a newly created closed-end interval fund (the "Interval Fund").

outcome_evidence.quote: announced today the completion of the reorganization (the “Reorganization”) of Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunities Fund (NYSE: VTA) (the “Fund”) into a newly created closed-end interval fund, Invesco Dynamic Credit Opportunity Fund (the “Interval Fund”).

deals.notes: Acquirer is a newly created closed-end interval fund (not exchange-listed; its share classes are priced daily at NAV), so the pair is not a listed pair. For the record the reorganization was completed effective November 1, 2021 after shareholder approval on September 3, 2021; VTA delisted from the NYSE at the close on October 28, 2021.
